ammonia.reason: Limited urea and amino acid deamination in 3-mo aged paste with brushed rind, not overripe.

animal_barnyard.reason: Trace p-cresol and indole plus sulfur from Brevibacterium linens rind smear proteolysis.

bitter.reason: Low hydrophobic peptide accumulation due to balanced rennet and thermophilic starter proteolysis at pH 6.29.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation so no C7-C11 methyl ketones and secondary alcohols.

browning.reason: Maillard between residual galactose and lysine on heating plus fat-promoted dehydration.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl and acetoin from citrate metabolism by mesophilic starters plus C4-C12 lactones in 31% milk fat.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Low free butyric 0.48 mmol/kg and hexanoic 0.08 mmol/kg from mild lipase and esterase lipolysis.

creaminess.reason: 31% fat at about 50% FDM lubricating intact protein matrix at pH 6.29.

crumbliness.reason: Elastic rennet-cooked curd with intact casein fractures little rather than crumbling.

firmness.reason: Semi-hard 37.9% moisture calcium-paracasein network cooked and pressed, aged 3 mo.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylethanol and phenylacetaldehyde from phenylalanine transamination by lactobacilli.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate and hexanoate from esterification of free fatty acids with ethanol by NSLAB esterases.

goaty.reason: Cow milk low in caprylic and capric free acids and no branched 4-methyloctanoic goat notes.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker 2- and 3-methylbutanal from leucine and isoleucine catabolism during 3-mo ripening.

melt.reason: pH 6.29 intact para-kappa-casein and 38% moisture allow flow without excessive crosslinking.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol and 1-octen-3-one from linoleic acid oxidation plus rind Geotrichum activity.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free oil release from coalesced 31% fat globules on melting with fairly stable emulsion.

smoky.reason: No wood smoking so no guaiacol and syringol phenols.

sour_vinegar.reason: Moderate acetic acid about 10.6 mmol/kg from heterofermentative metabolism buffered by high pH 6.29.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading so limited aligned casein fiber extensibility.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low methionine catabolism to methional and DMS; gentle 46-48C cooking retains some whey sulfur.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose and galactose plus sweet amino acids proline and alanine and diacetyl rounding.

umami.reason: Glutamate accumulation from rennet, plasmin and starter peptidase proteolysis.
